description: Express Loader is a commercial tool from New Century Software, a brand of the MISTRAS Group, for loading large amounts of pipeline data into a database built on the Pipeline Open Data Standard (PODS), for example from new construction, acquisitions, surveys or annual maintenance. The product page says it calculates and assigns linear referencing, maps source columns to target tables with an expression builder, understands parent and child tables in PODS and loads both in one transaction, validates data before loading at table and database level, groups validation messages, tracks features from GPS collection with their quality, links documents such as inspection reports and dig reports to PODS events, and can roll a load back. Mapping configurations are saved as reusable templates, and reports summarise load statistics and validation issues. Coverage: any pipeline operator's PODS database. Access: Windows desktop software on the Microsoft .NET Framework, with demos and brochures on request. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid; no price is published. Caveats: vendor description only, the stated operating systems are Windows 7 and 10, and the page does not say which PODS versions are supported. It prepares the pipeline network and asset data that network flow and resilience models need. It relates to the OGC PipelineML standard and the National Pipeline Mapping System in the catalogue.
